text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: service=redis-acceptqueue (severity=critical) — elevated 500s and accept-queue growing. Pager ID PD-4761

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: PD-4761 triggered for service redis-acceptqueue. No auto-acknowledge. Escalation policy: primary on-call.

oncall_tony: Acked. I'm on it. Pulling dashboards now. :eyes:

sre_ana: I'm nearby — can take Redis-side checks if needed.

db_julia: I'll look at pgbouncer/postgres metrics. Any customer-impact reports?

oncall_tony: Dashboards show redis accept-queue spike across shards ~10:11 UTC, clients rose ~4800 -> ~4980, errors in app logs: 'ERR max number of clients reached'.

oncall_tony: Sample from app log:
```
[2026-03-15T10:12:03Z] ERROR api: failed to acquire redis client: ERR max number of clients reached
```

infra_miguel: Ran `redis-cli -h redis-cluster-1 INFO clients` — output:
```
connected_clients:4987
client_longest_output_list:0
blocked_clients:23
```
We have a bunch of WAIT/blocked clients.

sre_ana: Could be cascading from a fanout (lots of background jobs) — pgbouncer/PG looks elevated too?

db_julia: pgbouncer quick stats:
```
active_clients: 612
waiting_clients: 42
server_active: 400
server_idle: 50
```
DB elevated but not critically saturated. Looks like cache layer hit first.

oncall_tony: product_ops — any deploys in the last 10m? :question:

product_ops: No infra deploys. We did see a traffic surge from a customer-initiated export job batch started ~10:05 UTC.

customer_success_ari: CS flag: two enterprise customers reporting intermittent 5xx on exports. They're pausing their jobs for now.

sre_ana: Triage plan: 1) temporary increase redis maxclients 2) short-term replica / scale out if feasible 3) apply app-side backpressure (rate-limit exports) 4) identify and drain long-lived worker connections.

db_julia: Agreed. I'll also check for connection leaks from worker pool and adjust pgbouncer if needed. Use `CLIENT LIST` to find long-lived conns.

oncall_tony: Executing step 1: issuing `CONFIG SET maxclients 10000` on redis-cluster-1 (will monitor).

incident-bot: CONFIG SET executed by oncall_tony. New maxclients=10000 (requested at 10:14:12 UTC).

infra_miguel: Re-checking clients after change:
```
connected_clients:5021
blocked_clients:6
```
Accept queue trending down. Errors dropping.

sre_ana: Pushing emergency rate-limit to edge for /api/v1/exports (nginx):
```
limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=export_zone:10m rate=5r/m;
```
Pushing rule now to reduce fanout.

oncall_tony: Rate limit deployed. Observed immediate decrease in blocked_clients and application 5xxs.

product_ops: Notifying CS to advise impacted customers to pause large exports; preparing post-incident outreach.

customer_success_ari: Message sent to affected accounts. One customer confirmed reduced errors after pause.

sre_ana: Stability update: metrics stable for ~3 minutes. Recommended follow-ups: audit worker pool for leaked connections, add circuit-breaker in client library to cap concurrent connections, consider autoscale policy for redis accept-queue thresholds.

db_julia: I'll file a follow-up ticket with immediate action items: investigate worker spawn pattern, tighten pgbouncer tuning, and schedule a Redis scaling runbook test.

oncall_tony: Handing off to db_julia for the postmortem and prevention work. Marking this incident as mitigated.

pagerduty-bot: PD-4761 acknowledged by oncall_tony; escalation paused.

db_julia: Taking ownership of follow-ups. Will post an incident summary and draft postmortem in #incidents within 24h.

incident-bot: Incident mitigated and thread closed (mitigated). Key metrics: redis_error_rate dropped from ~12% -> ~0.8%, accept_queue length normalized.

-- end of thread --
